chunks: Do you think you will enter Paradise while God has not yet known those who strive among you and known the patient ones?

key_terms.يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ: God knows (in the sense of distinguishing/testing)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God must 'know' the strivers and patient ones before entering Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that divine knowledge of true faith is actualized through the crucible of trials, distinguishing the steadfast from the merely nominal believers. It highlights that martyrdom and patience are not passive states but active proofs of sincerity, a concept central to the Imamate's own experience of suffering. Thus, entering Paradise requires not just belief, but the verified endurance of hardship as a means of spiritual purification.
